name: Shopify
description: Search a store's products and policies, and manage shopping carts.

methods.whenToUse: Recommended for Shopify's current UCP catalog, cart, and checkout tools.
methods.guidanceMd: Connect Shopify's current UCP server for shopper-facing catalog and commerce tools. Paperclip supplies the required agent profile automatically.
methods.label: Shopify UCP commerce

tenantFields.label: Store domain
tenantFields.helperMd: Enter the permanent myshopify.com domain without https://. Custom storefront domains are not the MCP endpoint.

warnings: This is Shopify's shopper-facing UCP server, not Admin API access. It does not manage merchant products or customers.
The storefront must be public. A private or password-protected storefront returns HTTP 401 even when the merchant is signed in to Shopify Admin.
Paperclip currently uses Shopify's documented hosted agent-profile fixture while Paperclip's production UCP profile is being established.

methods.whenToUse: Use Shopify's compatibility server when agents need storefront policy and FAQ search.
methods.guidanceMd: Connect Shopify's official Storefront MCP server for shopper-facing catalog, policy, and cart tools.
methods.label: Storefront policies and compatibility tools

tenantFields.label: Store domain
tenantFields.helperMd: Enter the permanent myshopify.com domain without https://. Custom storefront domains are not the MCP endpoint.

warnings: This is Shopify's Storefront MCP, not Admin API access. It does not manage merchant products, orders, or customers.
The storefront must be public. A private or password-protected storefront returns HTTP 401 even when the merchant is signed in to Shopify Admin.

setupPrerequisite.title: Launch the storefront before connecting
setupPrerequisite.description: Shopify's Storefront MCP is a public, no-auth endpoint. Paperclip cannot use the merchant's Shopify Admin session to bypass a private storefront.
steps: Select a Shopify plan; Shopify keeps trial storefronts private until a plan is selected.
In Shopify Admin, open Online Store → Preferences and set Storefront visibility to Public (remove password protection).
Use the permanent <store>.myshopify.com domain in Paperclip, even if the store also has a custom domain.
